title: Power Iteration
signature: def power_iteration(A: np.ndarray, v0: np.ndarray, n_iters: int) -> tuple
hints: Repeat v = A @ v, then v = v / ||v||. Normalizing every step keeps the numbers from overflowing.
Estimate the eigenvalue with the Rayleigh quotient v^T A v. Using ||A v|| loses the sign of a negative eigenvalue.
Normalize v0 before the first step too, so n_iters = 0 still returns a unit vector.
